category_edits.rationale: Condition each HSTU attention gate on the current normalized token while projecting the attended history separately. This may preserve current-item intent while selectively incorporating history. Applies to all four category models. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so checkpoint shapes and inference remain consistent automatically. Embeddings, positions, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.

edits.replace:
self.value = nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units)
        self.gate = nn.Linear(hidden_units, hidden_units)

edits.find:
value, gate = self.gate(attn_out).chunk(2, dim=-1)
        seq_emb = seq_emb + self.dropout(value * F.silu(gate))
edits.replace:
value = self.value(attn_out)
        gate = self.gate(normed)
        seq_emb = seq_emb + self.dropout(value * F.silu(gate))

change_summary: Use token-conditioned SiLU gates on projected causal attention outputs in every HSTU block across all four independently trained category models.
